# Flagler County Drug Court Foundation

> Recovery, hope and second chances for people in the Flagler County drug court program.

**What:** A Flagler County 501(c)(3) (founded 2009, EIN 27-1349987) supporting people in the Flagler County drug court program: transportation, fees, Narcan distribution and free overdose-response training, community events, and the Road to Recovery podcast.

**Where:** Palm Coast / Flagler County, Florida.

**Who it's for:** Drug-court participants and their families; donors and sponsors; anyone wanting free Narcan training.

**Cost:** Donations via Zeffy — monthly through Club 100 or one-time; business sponsorships. Narcan kits and training are free.

**Contact:** Email fcdcfoundation01@gmail.com or https://fcdc.ericolsen.studio/contact.html. Crisis: 988.

## Pages

- [About Us | Flagler County Drug Court Foundation](https://fcdc.ericolsen.studio/about.html): A Flagler County 501(c)(3) founded in 2009 by residents who believe in the drug court program. Our mission, vision, education work, and the volunteers behind it.
- [Contact & Volunteer | Flagler County Drug Court Foundation](https://fcdc.ericolsen.studio/contact.html): Reach the Flagler County Drug Court Foundation, request a Narcan training, volunteer, or ask about business sponsorship. Palm Coast, Florida.
- [How Drug Court Works | Flagler County Drug Court Foundation](https://fcdc.ericolsen.studio/drug-court.html): Drug court offers supervised treatment instead of incarceration for people with a substance use disorder. How the Flagler County program works, who is eligible, and what it costs taxpayers.
- [Events Calendar | Flagler County Drug Court Foundation](https://fcdc.ericolsen.studio/events.html): Upcoming Flagler County Drug Court Foundation events — the Ride for Recovery, the spring golf tournament, Dine to Donate nights, and free Narcan training classes.
- [Flagler County Drug Court Foundation | Recovery, Hope, Second Chances](https://fcdc.ericolsen.studio/): The Flagler County Drug Court Foundation helps people in the Flagler County drug court program recover — transportation, housing deposits, GEDs, specialized treatment, free Narcan and training. A local 501(c)(3) since 2009.
- [Free Narcan & Overdose Response Training | Flagler County](https://fcdc.ericolsen.studio/narcan.html): Free naloxone (Narcan) kits and overdose response training in Flagler County. The first local nonprofit to secure a Florida DCF grant to distribute Narcan at no cost, since 2019.
- [The Road to Recovery Podcast | Flagler County Drug Court Foundation](https://fcdc.ericolsen.studio/podcast.html): The Road to Recovery is the podcast of the Flagler County Drug Court Foundation — honest conversations with drug court graduates, families, counselors, and the local businesses that hire people in recovery.
- [Ways to Give | Flagler County Drug Court Foundation](https://fcdc.ericolsen.studio/ways-to-give.html): Give monthly through Club 100, make a one-time gift, sponsor as a local business, or give by mail. Every dollar stays in Flagler County. EIN 27-1349987.
